turns.input:
$figjam the Roamstay booking status lifecycle on a new board in our Roamstay Product plan, and add a short note on Cancelled and on No-show saying who sets each, so support knows who to ask. Pending until the card is authorised, then Confirmed, which covers Upcoming and In stay. Check-out ends it as Completed. A guest can cancel while Pending or Confirmed, and the hotel marks No-show after a missed check-in.
